title: ADL2
summary: A deep-learning project that predicts diabetic retinopathy from structured tabular clinical data rather than images, addressing class imbalance via SMOTENC and outlier detection before training PyTorch neural networks. SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer (with Metadata schema and evaluate_quality/run_diagnostic) are run to generate synthetic minority-class samples for data augmentation.
evidence: Preprocessing_Functions.py:46-57 instantiates CTGANSynthesizer/TVAESynthesizer with metadata to generate synthetic samples
